name: panda_pick_and_place_dense_v0_wall_clock
description: PandaGym pick-and-place benchmark with a fixed wall-clock training window and a blue ghost goal marker.
notes: Use this benchmark when comparing Panda pick-and-place training recipes under equal wall-clock time.
train_episodes is a high safety cap; train_seconds is the intended budget.
The HER seed is a natural alternative for this goal-conditioned manipulation task.

AutoresearchPandaPickAndPlaceDense-v0 delegates physics to PandaGym, recolors the non-collidable goal marker for visual clarity, and rejects reset samples that are already inside the success threshold.
